newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Copex BV appoints Pliot Air as U.S agent.
newsitem.headline: Copex BV appoints Pliot Air as U.S agent.

text.p: Dutch forwarder Copex Air BV has appointed a new agent for the whole of the U.S., a Copex spokesman said.

The new agent, Pilot Air Freight Corp is based in Lima, Philadelphia and has 55 offices throughout the U.S. Previously, the Dutch forwarder was working with F.X.Coughlin Co and several other U.S. companies.
"This follows our policy of employing one agent where possible and we appoint agents which can handle all transport modes", the spokesman told Reuters.

In March, Copex appointed Toronto-based Icecorp International Cargo Express as its Canadian agent for sea and air services. In the Middle East the Dutch company also operates a Dubai agent, Modern Freight. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+5017
